This isn’t a "dumb situation"—it’s a red flag you’re wise to recognize. A healthy partner would celebrate your friendships, respect your time, and not demand you prove your commitment through sacrifices. Keep moving forward—you deserve someone who uplifts you, not someone who tries to "own" you. (And yes, your cousin’s wedding is a big deal—walking with your female cousin is no issue at all. Her reaction was the problem, not the event.)
